title: 第3章 一纸休书第4章 母猪上树
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
三年没有修炼，如今重温这种烈火燃烧的感觉，转眼已经过去十天。
十天内，以‘永恒炼狱凤凰’为修炼主体，李天命观摩学习，修炼成果平分。
到了今日之后，一人一鸡身上，流转着相同质量和数量的兽元。
十天时间，贯穿到兽脉境第三重！
虽然是重修，但这个速度，对整个‘朱雀国’来说都是旷世奇闻。
他现在的体质，可以称作为‘永恒炼狱体’，其体质天赋，和伴生兽‘小黄鸡’区别不大。
这样的体质，本身就具备逆天的力量、速度天赋，成长空间何其巨大。
“见鬼了，现在兽脉境第三重的兽元，感觉比我当初以‘玄金诀’锻造出的第五重的玄金兽元都还要强！”
李天命运转着三条兽脉的兽元力量，这‘永恒炼狱兽元’简直就像是地底岩浆，灼热粗暴。
当这兽元在他的身上流转的时候，整个人就像是一座暗潮汹涌的火山。
整个房间的温度都在提升，一旦爆发，那就是火山喷发。
“我不过是这离火城普通一员，为何伴生空间除了诞生金羽，还存在这么多太古混沌巨兽？我有何特殊之处？”
他对自己的身世有些费解。
“伴生空间内，还有九个蛋，其中一个还在咔咔作响，就是还没裂纹，估计很快也会孵化，就是不知道，这又会是什么太古混沌巨兽？”
李天命对这第二个蛋充满了期待，对剩下所有的蛋更是充满了想象！
他在想有没有一种可能，自己能拥有十头太古混沌巨兽作为伴生兽？
到时候，骑着十头太古混沌巨兽，称霸天下，独尊环宇，建立三千后宫……
“虽然得到了不得的造化，等于重生了一次，而这一次重生，我定要走好未来的每一步，不再让人有欺辱我的机会。”
他目光灼热看着窗外，此后他想做什么，他心里非常清楚。
“更重要的是，不能再让母亲受伤了。”

本来母亲‘卫婧’这辈子已经很不走运了。
加上自己在炎黄学宫被废，这三年来她孤苦无助的样子，深深刻在了李天命的心里。
这次修炼结束，小黄鸡还在房间里呼呼大睡，李天命则结束修炼。
他记得很清楚，今天是母亲的生日。
……
“天命，修炼结束了吗？”
刚打开门，就看到母亲搬了张椅子，靠在门口睡着了，自己开门的声音惊醒了她。
“母亲，告诉你一个好消息，我这只伴生兽，绝对是超越五阶伴生兽的存在，你儿子马上就能卷土重来，呼风唤雨了。”
关于他伴生空间还有十颗蛋的秘密，天地之间只有他母亲一个人知道。
“吹牛不打草稿，我在窗户看到了，就是一只小鸡，你得看好点，省得让人炖了。”
卫婧微笑着说。
“你看到了？要不今晚我们就炖了，刚出生的，说不定味道挺鲜美。”
李天命扶着她起来，带她到院子里晒太阳。
“别胡来啊，你这熊孩子，人家小鸡挺可爱的。”
卫婧教训道。
“哈哈，逗你的。”
李天命让她在院子里坐下，然后烧了一桶热水，蹲下来给卫婧洗脚。
“记得要跟别人说，这是靠‘血神契约’得来的伴生兽。”
卫婧语重心长的叮嘱道。
“明白！”

所谓‘血神契约’，就是失去伴生兽的御兽师，找到凶兽未完全孵化的卵或者出生不到一天的幼崽，以特殊血祭秘法牵引，强行注入自己血脉，让对方成为自己伴生兽的秘法。
‘凶兽’和伴生兽不同，凶兽没有御兽师共生，潜藏山野，凶残暴戾。
content_en:
I haven't practiced for three years, and now I am reliving this feeling of burning fire. Ten days have passed in the blink of an eye.
Within ten days, with the 'Eternal Purgatory Phoenix' as the main body of cultivation, Li Tianming observed and studied, and the cultivation results were equally divided.
After today, one person and one chicken have the same quality and quantity of beast essence flowing in them.
In ten days, he reached the third level of the beast vein realm!
Although it was rebuilt, this speed is a unique thing for the entire "Suzaku Kingdom".
His current physique can be called the 'eternal purgatory body', and his physical talent is not much different from the companion beast 'Little Yellow Chicken'.
With such a physique, he possesses incredible strength and speed talents, and the room for growth is huge.
"Damn it, the beast element at the third level of the beast vein realm now feels stronger than the fifth level of the mysterious gold beast element that I forged with the 'Xuanjin Jue'!"
Li Tian's fate revolves around the beast energy power of the three beast veins. This 'eternal purgatory beast element' is simply like underground magma, hot and rough.
When this beast element circulates in his body, his whole person is like a volcano with surging undercurrents.
The temperature of the entire room is rising, and once it erupts, it is a volcanic eruption.
"I'm just an ordinary member of Lihuo City. Why are there so many ancient chaotic beasts in the companion space besides the birth of Golden Feather? What's so special about me?"
He is somewhat confused about his life experience.
"There are still nine eggs in the companion space. One of them is still rattling. It has no cracks yet. It is estimated that it will hatch soon. But I don't know. What kind of ancient chaotic beast could this be?"
Li Tianming was full of expectations for this second egg, and he was full of imagination for all the remaining eggs!
He was wondering if there was a possibility that he could have ten ancient chaotic beasts as companion beasts?
At that time, riding ten ancient chaotic beasts, he will dominate the world, dominate the world, and establish a harem of three thousand...
"Although I have received an incredible blessing, it is equivalent to being reborn. This time, I will take every step in the future well and no longer give people the opportunity to bully me."
He looked out the window with burning eyes. He knew very well what he wanted to do from now on.
"More importantly, my mother can't be hurt anymore."
It turns out that my mother ‘Wei Jing’ has been very unlucky in her life.
In addition, she was deposed in Yanhuang Academy, and her helpless appearance in the past three years was deeply ingrained in Li Tianming's heart.
At the end of this practice, the little yellow chicken was still sleeping soundly in the room, while Li Tianming ended his practice.
He remembered clearly that today was his mother's birthday.
…
"Destiny, is the training over?"
As soon as she opened the door, she saw her mother moving a chair and leaning against the door, falling asleep. The sound of opening the door woke her up.
"Mother, I have some good news for you. My companion beast is definitely an existence that surpasses the fifth-level companion beast. Your son will soon be able to make a comeback and control the wind and rain."
Regarding the secret of the ten eggs in his companion space, only his mother knows in the world.
"You don't have to make a draft when you're bragging. I saw it from the window. It was a little chicken. You have to watch it carefully to avoid making people stew."
Wei Jing said with a smile.
"Did you see it? How about we stew it tonight? The newborn baby might taste quite delicious."
Li Tianming helped her up and took her to the yard to bask in the sun.
"Don't be ridiculous, you naughty kid, my chick is quite cute."
Wei Jing lectured.
"Haha, just kidding you."
Li Tianming asked her to sit down in the yard, then heated a bucket of hot water and squatted down to wash Wei Jing's feet.
"Remember to tell others that this is a companion beast obtained through the 'Blood God Contract'."
Wei Jing warned earnestly.
"Understood!"
The so-called 'Blood God Contract' means that a beast master who has lost his companion beast will find the eggs that have not been fully hatched or the cubs that are less than one day old, and use a special blood ritual secret method to forcibly inject his own blood., the secret method to make the other party become your companion beast.
The 'ferocious beast' is different from the companion beast. The ferocious beast does not have a beast master to coexist with it. It hides in the mountains and wilds and is cruel and violent.
